mu_name_from: OpenMU Version075 Items/Armors.cs:50 and mu.db's items row (group 6, index 14) name it the Legendary Shield against Item/Shield15.bmd.
why_this_one: Drop level 48: the Ice Queen leaves it. The Wizard's and the Elf's. See docs/devias-drops.md.
sheet_from: Data/Item/shield11.OZT (32x128, 49% cut away) on 106 triangles, shield11_a.OZJ (16x32, blue noise) on 52.
cutout_note: Declared, not sniffed (tools/asset.sh reads `cutout`). shield11 is a TGA and its frame is fretwork.
material_overrides_note: Steel's own 0.2 mirrors the grass; the Devias batch settled on 0.45 (plate 0.5) after the studio caught black heads and flaring shafts.
glow_note: `case MODEL_LEGENDARY_SHIELD: BlendMesh = 1; BlendMeshTexCoordU/V = (rand()%10)*0.1` (ZzzObject.cpp:5270-5274): the blue noise jumps every frame, a shimmer across the face. Drawn added on its raw sheet, the jump in V only (content::Material::jitter).
material_note: Near black with gold edges (0,0,0 to 47,35,12) -- plate; the fretwork island (74 triangles, orange-gold 229,135,64, 58 of 255 alpha on average) is brass. The shimmer face is the glow part (shield11_a).
